# Living Lundin

> Private Pilates with Taylor, a Balanced Body Comprehensive certified instructor. In-home private sessions on your own equipment across Seattle's Eastside (Bellevue, Medina, Issaquah, Snoqualmie & North Bend), virtual private sessions anywhere, and workshops & events.

Taylor blends a Classical foundation with a contemporary approach across the full Pilates system: Mat, Reformer, Cadillac/Trapeze Table, Chair and Barrels. She has taught more than 2,500 classes and has specialty training in Pre & Postnatal Pilates (Bodyline), the Oov, and Wellround Myofascial Release, plus hundreds of hours working one-on-one with clients who have scoliosis.

## Services

- [In-Person Privates](https://livinglundin.com/services.html): A concierge Pilates experience in your home, built around your schedule, your space and your equipment. Starting at $130 per 1-hour session. Includes hands-on corrections, use of additional props and sessions tailored to your goals. Available in Bellevue, Medina, Issaquah, Snoqualmie & North Bend, WA.
- [Virtual Privates](https://livinglundin.com/services.html): A custom flow designed for your home equipment, goals and skill level, with verbal cueing and flexible booking. Starting at $90 per 1-hour session. Available anywhere.
- [Workshops & Events](https://livinglundin.com/services.html): Customized group sessions for studios, corporate events, bachelorette parties, birthdays and more, at your home or venue. Inquire for pricing.

## Equipment

- Supported apparatus: Mat, Reformer, Cadillac, Chair, Barrels.
- Approved reformer brands: Balanced Body, Merrithew, Peak Pilates, Your Reformer. Custom setups are welcome to reach out.

## Contact and booking

- Email: taylorlundin4@gmail.com
- To book, email with your goals, the equipment you have at home, the days and times that work for you, and whether you want In-Person Privates (include your location) or Virtual Privates. Many clients come through referrals, and new clients are welcome to reach out.
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/livinglundin
